events.title: Demo Out Now!
events.summary: Hi everyone, the Steam demo is now out for you to play.The demo contains revamped UI, greatly enhanced progression, several new resource systems, and a new research tree, and many environmental changes, among other things. It also contains 9+ buildings, 14+ unique units, and about 2 hours of content progression.If interested, you can support the game by checking out the demo and wishlisting the full game on Steam.Thank you for playing!Chugget

events.title: Playtest Available Now (+ demo soon)
events.summary: If you are interested in playing the game in a less polished state and giving feedback on the current state of the game, please sign up for the playtest which has now begun from the main page.The demo will release in the coming weeks after the playtests are over, and after that, playtest will be used as a way to test new features going into the main game!Best, Chugget
